sequences.summary: Standard level 100 Dark Knight opener arranged around common raid-buff timing. This training-dummy version omits pre-pull The Blackest Night because the shield will not break, and it does not track the Strength Gemdraught item use.

startPrompt.text: Begin with Unmend when you are ready. Your first correct action starts the opener, kupo!

mistakePrompt.text: That action was out of sequence. The opener has reset and is ready for another attempt.

completionPrompt.text: Opener complete. Every planned action landed in order, kupo!

steps.advice: Unmend starts the GCD rolling while slightly delaying the heavy hits for typical raid-buff application.
steps.timing: Use roughly one second before the pull finishes.
steps.commonMistake: Opening with Hard Slash changes the alignment and requires an extra Hard Slash later.

steps.advice: Edge of Shadow applies Darkside early and begins spending MP before you can overcap.
steps.timing: Weave before Hard Slash only when doing so will not clip the GCD.
steps.commonMistake: Forcing this weave from long range can delay Hard Slash. Move it after Hard Slash instead if needed.

steps.advice: Hard Slash begins the Souleater combo. In real encounters, use your Grade 4 Gemdraught of Strength shortly before this GCD.
steps.timing: Enter melee range promptly after Unmend and keep the GCD rolling.
steps.commonMistake: Arriving late to melee range delays every burst action that follows.

steps.advice: Living Shadow has a long spawn delay and updates with buffs in real time, so summon it before raid buffs appear.
steps.timing: Use immediately after the first melee GCD.
steps.commonMistake: Delaying Living Shadow can push its final attacks outside party buffs.

prompt.text: Living Shadow goes out early so its full sequence reaches the raid-buff window.

steps.advice: Syphon Strike continues the combo and restores MP, helping fund the Edge casts inside the burst.
steps.timing: Use immediately when the GCD becomes available.
steps.commonMistake: Breaking the combo loses both damage and resource generation.

steps.advice: Souleater completes the basic combo and generates Blood before the main burst begins.
steps.timing: Finish the full combo before releasing the delayed high-potency actions.
steps.commonMistake: Starting the burst too early can place the strongest hits before party buffs are active.

steps.advice: Delirium enables the Scarlet Delirium combo and generates MP during the burst.
steps.timing: Align it with raid buffs and the upcoming three-GCD Delirium combo.
steps.commonMistake: Entering Delirium above 70 Blood can overcap. Spend Blood beforehand when necessary.

prompt.text: The main burst begins now. Keep the Delirium GCDs moving while weaving your cooldowns.

steps.advice: Disesteem is granted by Living Shadow and provides a powerful GCD for the even-minute burst.
steps.timing: Delay it until party buffs are expected to be active.
steps.commonMistake: Using Disesteem immediately when it appears can place it before raid buffs.

steps.advice: Salted Earth is a 90-second offensive cooldown and should generally be used as soon as its planned window arrives.
steps.timing: Place it before the Delirium combo so its damage begins inside the burst.
steps.commonMistake: Holding it unnecessarily loses uses over the encounter.

steps.advice: This Edge of Shadow converts banked MP into damage while raid buffs are active.
steps.timing: Weave it without clipping and continue spending as Delirium restores MP.
steps.commonMistake: Entering the burst near the MP cap and delaying Edge can waste incoming MP.

steps.advice: Scarlet Delirium begins the three-part Delirium weaponskill combo.
steps.timing: Keep the GCD rolling and weave burst abilities between these weaponskills.
steps.commonMistake: Pausing between Delirium GCDs can lose buff coverage.

prompt.text: Keep the Delirium combo moving while weaving the remaining burst abilities.

steps.advice: Shadowbringer has two charges. Both belong in even-minute raid buffs whenever possible.
steps.timing: Weave the first charge here and reserve the second for later in the same burst.
steps.commonMistake: Sitting on both charges risks losing a use and wastes raid-buff damage.

steps.advice: A second Edge spends the MP generated during Delirium while preserving room for further regeneration.
steps.timing: Weave after Scarlet Delirium without clipping the next GCD.
steps.commonMistake: Failing to spend MP during Delirium can cause an overcap before the burst ends.

steps.advice: Comeuppance is the second GCD of the Delirium combo and continues generating burst resources.
steps.timing: Use directly after Scarlet Delirium.
steps.commonMistake: Replacing it with a normal combo GCD interrupts the Delirium sequence.

steps.advice: Carve and Spit is a one-minute offensive cooldown that also restores MP.
steps.timing: Use promptly in each minute burst so it stays aligned with punctual raid buffs.
steps.commonMistake: Delaying it repeatedly can push later uses outside buff windows.

steps.advice: This Edge immediately spends the MP returned by Delirium and Carve and Spit.
steps.timing: Use it inside the same weave window only when your skill speed and latency permit it without clipping.
steps.commonMistake: Prioritising an aggressive double weave over the next GCD can reduce total damage.

steps.advice: Torcleaver completes the Delirium combo and is one of the highest-value GCDs in the burst.
steps.timing: Land it while party buffs and the Strength Gemdraught are active.
steps.commonMistake: Drifting the Delirium sequence can push Torcleaver outside short raid buffs.

steps.advice: The second Shadowbringer charge completes the pair reserved for the even-minute burst.
steps.timing: Use before the raid-buff window closes.
steps.commonMistake: Saving this charge for later weakens the two-minute burst and may cause charge overcap.

steps.advice: Bloodspiller spends banked Blood for an additional high-potency GCD during buffs.
steps.timing: Even-minute bursts should include at least one extra Bloodspiller beyond the Delirium combo.
steps.commonMistake: Spending too much Blood before the burst can leave this GCD unavailable.

steps.advice: Salt and Darkness detonates Salted Earth for additional burst damage.
steps.timing: Use before Salted Earth expires and while buffs remain active where possible.
steps.commonMistake: Forgetting the follow-up wastes a large portion of Salted Earth's value.
